"The line integral with respect to $x$ of the function $f(x,y)$ along the path $C$ can be calculated using the formula

$$
\int_C f(x,y)\,\textrm d x = \int\limits_a^b  f(\mathbf r(t)) \, \dfrac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t} \, \textrm{d}t,
